entries.zh: 信用；给人信用、信服（对他人之言予以采信）
entries.en: credit; to give credit, to believe and be convinced

entries.zh: 心悦诚服；甘心归服（在意志与理智上顺服）
entries.en: to grow in yielding one's will and understanding; to submit heart and mind
entries.notes: L 栏末尾「entendimientos a」悬置不全，义据「心服」定。

entries.zh: 征信；相信他人所说的话
entries.en: to believe what one is told; to give credence

entries.zh: 信誉；有信用、为人所凭信
entries.en: credit, reputation; to have credit, to be trusted

entries.notes: L 栏空缺，据汉字「潮」及本页「水漲」诸条类聚定为潮水之潮。

entries.en: to rise, to swell (of water); to surge up
the water rises; a rising of the water

entries.zh: 向外长出、突出（物自内溢出于外）
entries.en: to grow outward, to protrude; to come forth
entries.notes: L 栏「saliendo fuera」语义含混，汉字「逐」与 M 栏 jiog 音合而义未安。
四栏俱空，仅存污损痕迹（T99），无从释义。

entries.en: to rise in dignity and rank; to be advanced in honours
entries.notes: 汉字「共/步」存疑，且 R 栏 gun 与 M 栏 pou 不合，义仅据 L 栏。

entries.en: to grow in power; for one's might to increase
entries.notes: H 栏「桑」与 M/R 音（gui/kui）不合，疑为「貴」之误，义据 L 栏。

entries.en: to grow dim (of twilight); for the dusk to thicken
entries.notes: M 栏夹注西文「quiere crexer」（意为渐长），可证此条取「渐增」义。

entries.zh: 矇眬；暮色迷蒙、景象模糊
entries.en: to grow hazy; dim, blurred (of twilight)

entries.zh: 髻；鸟冠（头顶羽冠，形似发髻）
entries.notes: L 栏「Aue」当为 Ave（鸟）；「髻」本指发髻，借以状鸟冠。

entries.en: crest of feathers, tassel (英 written for 纓)
entries.notes: 「英」当为「纓」之借字，与 L 栏鸟冠相承。
L 栏「Ga Lino」为 gallo（公鸡）之讹写。
四栏俱空，仅存污损痕迹（T99），无从释义。
L 栏「Crianca」取 crianza（教养、礼节）义，非「幼儿」。

entries.zh: 识尊卑；懂得长幼尊卑之礼
entries.en: to know one's place; to know proper deference between high and low
